avoid_attribution.win_if: locked_verdict does not assign this player at or above specified liability level for this crime

pin_target.win_if: locked_verdict assigns target player at or above liability threshold, regardless of whether the investigators are correct
pin_target.avoid_auto_win: target player currently present and case evidence creates a defensible contested issue

protect_ally.win_if: locked_verdict does not assign ally at or above liability threshold, and target is present
protect_ally.avoid_auto_win: ally must be plausible suspect in this variant, not guaranteed already excluded

retain_interest.win_if: authenticated server endgame business state records interest held

approved_protection.win_if: competent authority explicitly approved actual protection at requested level
